title: Joint Learning of Factual and Counterfactual Worlds for Causal Prior-data Fitted Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.19710v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Estimating treatment effects is central to science across many disciplines and requires counterfactual reasoning about alternative worlds. In the real world, however, each unit reveals its outcome only under the factual world. Thus, the factual and counterfactual outcomes can never be jointly learned by any model trained on real data. The problem is therefore tractable only in synthetic settings, where both worlds can be generated. Recent progress on prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) has shown that models pre-trained purely on synthetic data can transfer to real-world prediction. This paradigm has since carried over to causal effect estimation. Despite this fully synthetic setup, existing causal PFNs carry the real-world constraint into their training objective, confining learning to a single world's outcome per unit. translated_title: 面向因果先验数据拟合网络的事实世界与反事实世界联合学习
translated_abstract: 估计处理效应是许多学科科学研究的核心，需要对替代世界进行反事实推理。然而在现实世界中，每个单元只会在事实世界下揭示其结果，因此任何基于真实数据训练的模型都无法联合学习事实结果与反事实结果。因此，该问题只有在可以同时生成两个世界的合成环境中才可求解。先验数据拟合网络（PFNs）的最新进展表明，完全在合成数据上预训练的模型可以迁移到现实世界的预测任务中，这一范式随后也被应用于因果效应估计。尽管处于这种完全合成的设置中，现有的因果PFN仍将现实世界的约束带入其训练目标，把每个单元的学习限制在单一世界的结果上，从而丢失了两个世界之间的依赖关系，处理效应的密度默认依赖于独立性假设。
tldr: 该论文提出一种新的因果先验数据拟合网络，通过在合成环境中联合学习每个单元的事实与反事实两个世界的结果并利用二者间的依赖关系，突破了现有因果PFN只能学习单一世界结果的限制，从而提升处理效应的估计效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a causal prior-data fitted network that jointly learns the factual and counterfactual outcomes of each unit in synthetic settings, exploiting the dependence between the two worlds to overcome the single-world limitation of existing causal PFNs and improve treatment effect estimation.
